answer: Through the jade, the economy stays open to anyone willing to pay the price of entry, and closed to free clones. A newcomer enters only when an established sponsor locks a bond behind it, and the bond is slashed if the newcomer is later proven fake. The tundra check ties the sponsor's own standing to every vouch, so backing a thousand clones needs a thousand sponsors willing to lose money and reputation. The canyon turns sybil resistance into bookkeeping: if the cost per fake exceeds the reward per fake, the attack dies.
